boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named UC Merced spaces for studying, making, recreation, and quiet reflection, with access details from university sources.

cards.entity_name: 24/7 Study in KL 155, First Floor Lantern
cards.title: First Floor Lantern
cards.subtitle: Kolligian Library, KL 155
cards.notes: Use the first-come study area when you need a late study session; after-hours entry is through the Library East Wing’s south sliding doors.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced identifies KL 155, the First Floor Lantern, as a 24-hour study area for students, staff, and faculty.
cards.source_title: Study & Collaborative Spaces | UC Merced Library
cards.access_notes: Eligible users are students, staff, and faculty; first-come basis. The source states it is a 24-hour study area.

cards.title: McFadden-Willis Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Kolligian Library, KL 455
cards.notes: Head to this fourth-floor room for a designated quiet-study setting; it is first-come, so bring your materials and settle in respectfully.
cards.short_summary: A named fourth-floor quiet study room.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced designates the McFadden-Willis Reading Room, KL 455, as a quiet study area.
cards.source_title: Study & Collaborative Spaces | UC Merced Library
cards.access_notes: Located on the Library’s fourth floor; eligible users are students, staff, and faculty, on a first-come basis.

cards.title: Collaborative Work Rooms
cards.subtitle: Kolligian Library
cards.notes: Reserve a room for a group assignment or collaborative study session; use Library Meeting Rooms instead when the purpose is non-academic.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms for academic group work.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced Library says its Collaborative Work Rooms can be reserved for academic activities, group assignments, and collaborative study.
cards.source_title: Study & Collaborative Spaces | UC Merced Library
cards.access_notes: Eligible users are undergraduate and graduate students; reservations are for academic activities.

cards.title: Gonella Discovery Room Data Lab
cards.subtitle: Kolligian Library, KL 260
cards.notes: Visit the second-floor data lab to work with its computers, digital whiteboard, and projection screen; check the events calendar around workshops or reservations.
cards.short_summary: An informal data and technology workspace.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gonella Discovery Room Data Lab has 12 computer workstations, a digital whiteboard, and a large projection screen.
cards.source_title: Gonella Discovery Room Data Lab | UC Merced Library
cards.access_notes: KL 260 is on the Library’s second floor; open-lab access may change when workshops or reservations are scheduled.

cards.title: Kolligian Library Study Pods
cards.subtitle: Kolligian Library, second floor
cards.notes: Look for the study pods on the second floor when you want a smaller library setting; combine the stop with the library’s mapped study spaces.
cards.short_summary: Named study pods documented by the library.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced Library documents study pods on the second floor of the Kolligian Library Building.
cards.source_title: The Story of the Library | UC Merced Library
cards.access_notes: Library access and building hours apply; consult the library’s current space information before visiting.

cards.title: Writing Center
cards.subtitle: Kolligian Library, KL 260
cards.notes: Plan a writing-support stop in KL 260, then use nearby library study areas to revise; confirm appointment or service details before relying on a visit.
cards.short_summary: A named writing-support location in the library.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced Library lists the Writing Center in room KL 260 among its library spaces.
cards.source_title: Use Library Spaces | UC Merced Library
cards.access_notes: Located in KL 260; verify current Writing Center service and appointment arrangements before visiting.

cards.title: The Labyrinth at UC Merced
cards.subtitle: Kelley Grove, beside The Pavilion
cards.notes: Walk the Baltic Wheel pattern for a reflective outdoor pause; use the accessible sidewalk beginning near The Pavilion Dining Center entrance.
cards.short_summary: A free, public outdoor reflection space.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced says The Labyrinth is free and open to the public daily from dawn until dusk.
cards.access_notes: Located on Little Lake’s shore in Kelley Grove; open daily from dawn until dusk, with an accessible sidewalk near The Pavilion entrance.

cards.entity_name: Joseph Edward Gallo Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.title: Gallo Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.subtitle: UC Merced campus
cards.notes: Use the recreation center for fitness programming or drop-in basketball, badminton, and volleyball; check current eligibility and facility rules before arrival.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation facility for fitness and drop-in activities.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced says the Gallo Recreation and Wellness Center offers fitness programming and drop-in basketball, badminton, and volleyball.
cards.access_notes: Facility access and programming are subject to current Recreation and Athletics eligibility, schedules, and rules.

cards.title: Student Activities and Athletics Center
cards.subtitle: UC Merced campus
cards.notes: Use this recreation hub for scheduled fitness programming or drop-in court activities, and check its current facility access requirements before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A student recreation hub with court activities.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced says the Student Activities and Athletics Center features fitness programming plus drop-in basketball, badminton, and volleyball.
cards.access_notes: The center is a Recreation and Athletics facility; confirm current access eligibility, programming, and operating information before visiting.

cards.title: UC Merced Outdoor Center
cards.subtitle: Student Activities and Athletics Center
cards.notes: Stop by to speak with Outdoor Experience Program staff, browse its small library, or learn about bicycle sessions, trips, and equipment rentals.
cards.short_summary: The campus hub for Outdoor Experience Program resources.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced identifies the Outdoor Center in the Student Activities and Athletics Center as the home of its Outdoor Experience Program.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Student Activities and Athletics Center; program activities and equipment rentals may have separate arrangements.
